External Reference Checkouts
============================

Use this directory for local source checkouts that are useful as implementation
references but are not vendored build dependencies.

Current local reference checkouts:

- `cc-connect/` from https://github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect
- `cc-switch/` from https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch

The checkout directories themselves are ignored by Git. Keep durable notes or
patches in tracked project files instead of editing these reference copies.
